youtube.title: Ben Franklin tried to fix daylight saving time ⏰ Napoleon's brunch did not survive #shorts
youtube.caption:
Clocks fall back this weekend. Ben Franklin had one job. ⏰🥞

Napoleon planned brunch to the minute. Franklin "fixed" daylight saving time.

Which 11 would YOU show up at? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Fun fact: in 1784 Franklin wrote a satirical essay telling Parisians to wake up earlier to save candles — often called the first daylight saving idea.

#daylightsavingtime #fallback #benjaminfranklin #napoleon #historymemes #shorts
